Jethalal discusses upcoming festival sales strategies with Natu Kaka and Bagha. A customer enters examining multiple appliances merely to pass time, leading to comic relief. Soon after, Ratan Bhai drops by and offers Jethalal a ride home on his scooter.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
